messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for service 'inference-gateway' -> group 'stable->canary' (batch 2/10). Preflight probes enabled. Namespace: prod-west. Tag: v2026.03.14-canary

incident-bot: @channel On-call page: Ben (oncall) — preflight probe failures detected in canary batch 2. Pager: P1 if >50% canary failures; P2 otherwise.

Ben (oncall): grabbing. Seeing spike in 5xx from canary pods in prod-west. Any quick rollback toggle?

Alice: omg 5xxs look like 502 gateway. Not seeing infra CPU pressure. Possibly routing config? We'll check.

Charlie-SRE: pulling logs now. TLDR: readiness probe failing with 502 on /healthz for new image. kv cache miss? Will paste logs.

Charlie-SRE: ```
kubectl logs deploy/inference-gateway-canary-2 -n prod-west --since=5m
... ERROR http: upstream: read tcp 10.2.3.4:5000->10.2.4.5:45321: connection reset by peer
Traceback: ...
``` 

Ben (oncall): rate of failures ~4.8% of requests vs baseline 0.03%. Not yet P1 but rolling. Abort criteria: abort if any canary batch >2% 5xx for 5m? that's triggered. I'm going to flip the feature flag to route all traffic to stable.

maria: customers on SLO: some mid-tier tenants seeing request errors, support already getting tickets. Please escalate if rollback takes >10m.

Ben (oncall): initiating kill-switch. Using infra-runbook step.

Ben (oncall): ```
# toggle feature flag
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle" -d '{"flag":"new-routing","state":"off","apply_to":"prod-west"}' 
# then scale down canary
kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway-canary --replicas=0 -n prod-west
``` 

Charlie-SRE: executed toggle, flag API returned 200. Scaled down canary pods now. Watching metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary batch 2 aborted by Ben (oncall). Rollback initiated to stable tag v2026.02.11.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-7. Severity: P2. Customers: multiple tenant errors, degradation, no data loss. Channel: #incidents.

maria: pinging support to update status page. ETA for full recovery? 

Charlie-SRE: latency and errors dropping already. 5xx back to 0.05% within 90s. Will keep monitoring for 15m.

ops-lead: good. Ben, please prep a short handoff note for the next oncall at rotation. Also include the toggles we exercised and the commit hash. 

Ben (oncall): noted. commit: 0a1b2c3 - canary image. Handoff: need to follow up on root cause: readiness path fails under certain connection patterns. Will open ticket.

Alice: agree. I saw stack trace mentioning upstream connection reset, could be new HTTP client changes in image. Adding a link to the PR: https://git.redwood/inference/PR/4567

Ben (oncall): passing to night oncall in 35m. If anything flares, escalate to Charlie and ops-lead. Closing the paging loop now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Page closed by Ben (oncall). Summary: preflight probe failures in canary batch -> feature-flag kill-switch toggled -> canary scaled down -> rollback to stable -> errors mitigated. Follow-up: root-cause ticket INF-987.

ops-lead: assign postmortem owner please. I'd like timeline + metrics + suggested rollback automation.

Ben (oncall): assigning to Alice. I'll write up the timeline and include logs.
